summary: Made local publication gates catch the same required Vulture and Lychee blockers as .github/workflows/tests.yml, and resolved the reproduced svd-ai-lab/open-engineer 404 without a broad github.com suppression. scripts/hooks/pre-push now runs the dead-code and broken-links gates on every push and fails closed when either tool is missing or returns nonzero (missing lychee blocks with install instructions; missing vulture surfaces as a failed gate via python -m). The Makefile exposes make vulture and make lychee with the exact CI commands and includes both in make ci while preserving lint/typecheck/test-ci/ui-test/ui-build. Regression tests pin vulture/lychee parity against the workflow, verify make ci composition and .PHONY, and prove fail-closed behavior for a missing lychee. The docs 404 was fixed by pointing the dead repo URL at the live owning org (https://github.com/svd-ai-lab, 200) with a dated note, leaving .lycheeignore untouched. Implemented and committed as 9ed8feb47135a92a4ef36200e21c3273aedf9844 on kittybuilder/kb_msudvnes_9eaa; all four declared validation commands pass.
